# 2 Chronicles Chapter 28 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Son-of twenty years was-Ahaz in-his-reigning and-sixteen years he-reigned in-Jerusalem and-not he-did the-right in-eyes-of YHWH like-David his-father.

**2** And-he-walked in-ways-of kings-of Israel and-also molten-images he-made for-the-Baals.

**3** And-he he-burned-incense in-valley-of son-of Hinnom and-he-burned his-sons in-the-fire according-to-abominations-of the-nations that dispossessed YHWH from-before sons-of Israel.

**4** And-he-sacrificed and-he-burned-incense on-the-high-places and-on the-hills and-under every tree green.

**5** And-He-gave-him YHWH his-God in-hand-of king-of Aram and-they-struck against-him and-they-took-captive from-him captivity great and-they-brought to-Damascus and-also in-hand-of king-of Israel he-was-given and-he-struck against-him a-striking great.

**6** And-he-killed Pekah son-of Remaliah in-Judah a-hundred and-twenty thousand in-day one all sons-of valor because-they-forsook YHWH God-of their-fathers.

**7** And-he-killed Zichri mighty-of Ephraim Maaseiah son-of the-king and-Azrikam leader-of the-house and-Elkanah second-to the-king.

**8** And-they-took-captive sons-of Israel from-their-brothers two-hundred thousand women sons and-daughters and-also plunder much they-plundered from-them and-they-brought the-plunder to-Samaria.

**9** And-there was a-prophet of-YHWH there Oded was-his-name and-he-went-out before the-army the-coming to-Samaria and-he-said to-them behold in-wrath-of YHWH God-of your-fathers against Judah He-gave-them in-your-hand and-you-killed against-them in-a-rage that to the-heavens has-reached.

**10** And-now sons-of Judah and-Jerusalem you are-saying to-subdue for-slaves and-slave-girls for-you is-there-not only with-you guilts to-YHWH your-God.

**11** And-now hear-me and-return the-captives that you-took-captive from-your-brothers for burning anger-of YHWH is-upon you.

**12** And-they-stood men from-heads-of sons-of Ephraim Azariah son-of Jehohanan Berechiah son-of Meshillemoth and-Jehizkiah son-of Shallum and-Amasa son-of Hadlai against the-coming from the-war.

**13** And-they-said to-them not you-shall-bring the-captives here for guilt-of YHWH upon-us you are-saying to-add upon our-sins and-upon our-guilt for great is-the-guilt to-us and-burning anger upon Israel.

**14** And-they-left the-armed-ones the-captives and-the-plunder before the-princes and-all the-assembly.

**15** And-they-arose the-men who were-designated by-names and-they-took the-captives and-all their-naked-ones they-clothed from the-plunder and-they-clothed-them and-they-shod-them and-they-fed-them and-they-gave-them-drink and-they-anointed-them and-they-led on-donkeys every-feeble-one and-they-brought-them to-Jericho city-of the-palms beside their-brothers and-they-returned to-Samaria.

**16** At-the-time that sent the-king Ahaz to kings-of Assyria to-help him.

**17** And-again the-Edomites came and-they-struck in-Judah and-they-took captives.

**18** And-the-Philistines raided the-cities-of the-Shephelah and-the-Negev of-Judah and-they-captured Beth-shemesh and-Aijalon and-Gederoth and-Soco and-its-daughters and-Timnah and-its-daughters and-Gimzo and-its-daughters and-they-dwelt there.

**19** For humbled YHWH Judah because-of Ahaz king-of Israel for he-made-naked Judah and-being-unfaithful unfaithful against-YHWH.

**20** And-he-came against-him Tilgath-pilneser king-of Assyria and-he-distressed-him and-not he-strengthened-him.

**21** For divided Ahaz house-of YHWH and-house-of the-king and-the-princes and-he-gave to-king-of Assyria and-not for-help to-him.

**22** And-in-time-of his-distress and-he-added to-be-unfaithful against-YHWH he was the-king Ahaz.

**23** And-he-sacrificed to-gods-of Damascus the-striking against-him and-he-said for gods-of kings-of Aram they are-helping them to-them I-will-sacrifice and-they-will-help-me and-they were to-him to-cause-him-to-stumble and-to-all Israel.

**24** And-he-gathered Ahaz vessels-of house-of God and-he-cut-in-pieces vessels-of house-of God and-he-closed doors-of house-of YHWH and-he-made for-himself altars in-every corner in-Jerusalem.

**25** And-in-every city and-city of-Judah he-made high-places to-burn-incense to-gods other and-he-provoked-to-anger YHWH God-of his-fathers.

**26** And-rest-of his-acts and-all his-ways the-first and-the-last behold-them written on book-of kings-of Judah and-Israel.

**27** And-he-lay-down Ahaz with his-fathers and-they-buried-him in-the-city in-Jerusalem for not they-brought-him to-tombs-of kings-of Israel and-he-reigned Hezekiah his-son in-his-place.


---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **28:3**: he-burned his-sons in-the-fire — Child sacrifice, the ultimate abomination. Ahaz descends to practices that Israel was sent to destroy.

- **28:9-11**: prophet Oded — A northern prophet condemns northern Israel for excessive violence against Judah. Even the victors are accountable to YHWH's moral standards.

- **28:15**: they-clothed-them and-they-shod-them and-they-fed-them — The Ephraimite act of mercy toward Judean captives anticipates the Good Samaritan parable. Enemies become caregivers.

- **28:22**: he-added to-be-unfaithful — The Chronicler's recurring pattern: distress should produce repentance, but Ahaz responds to trouble with more apostasy.


— EMET
